worldcombat.skill.takedown.summary: The plainest full-power shoulder charge: duck low, dash a short way and slam the target with your whole body. A hit reflects the impact onto you; a miss just skids you to a stop. The hit anyone can afford.
worldcombat.skill.takedown.description.0: The charge deals %1$s contact damage, dashing up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block collision radius.
worldcombat.skill.takedown.description.1: On a hit the user takes %1$s%% of the actual damage as recoil, shoves the target %2$s blocks and bounces back %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.takedown.description.2: Current run-up %1$s blocks: a longer run-up raises power and reach, and the recoil and wind-up with them.
worldcombat.skill.takedown.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.takedown.growth.0: From level %1$s the charge power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.takedown.growth.1: From level %1$s the charge power rises to %2$s and knockback to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.takedown.use.0: Shove a target in your face with a cheap shoulder charge
worldcombat.skill.takedown.use.1: Interrupt and open space before you get hit
worldcombat.skill.takedown.use.2: Finish a low-health target with one last charge
worldcombat.skill.takedown.preference.ru: Distance you run up before the hit. Longer raises power, reach and knockback, but the recoil, dust and wind-up rise with it; 0 charges from a standstill - fastest to fire and lightest on you.
worldcombat.skill.takedown.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts charges sooner, and whiffs more easily.
On: prefer Take Down against targets below a third health to finish them. Off: compete by the shared order only.
